sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Student Placement and Golden Visa Residence Advisory

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Islamic Sharia as source of legislation; codified civil/commercial statutes based on civil law principles; unitary national statutory framework)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: US-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 January 2009)
EFTA-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 July 2009)
Oman-Singapore Free Trade Agreement (in force 1 September 2008)
Oman-U.K. Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (effective 1 January 1992)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: AML/CFT Law (Royal Decree No. 30/2016) as amended; Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019) Articles 17 and 45; Executive Regulations of the Commercial Registry (Ministerial Decision No. 118/2019); Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Rules under MoCIIP Decision No. 88/2019; Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT Guidelines (EDPBS 6/2016).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each full passport (all pages or bio-data and signature page) of every UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or gazetted attestation authority in the passport-issuing country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (through the Omani Embassy/Consulate in the country of issuance)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Conduct (police clearance certificate) issued within the last 3 months for every UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, INTERPOL branch, or designated government background-check authority of the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Omani Embassy/Consulate prior authorization of the issuing authority)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and good relationship of the UBO/director (from the originating financial institution)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Executing bank's compliance officer / branch manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (letter must be notarized locally and legalized by the Omani embassy or consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or tenancy contract not older than 3 months) in the name of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company / licensed landlord or notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarized in origin country and legalized by Omani diplomatic mission)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and senior compliance personnel against (i) UN Security Council Consolidated List; (ii) OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Sanctions Lists; (iii) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions Lists; (iv) HM Treasury Consolidated List; and (v) the national sanctions list of the Omani Ministry of Foreign Affairs. PEP screening is required for all domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, operating in either first-degree relatives or close associates, with enhanced due diligence mandated for high-risk countries, and full documentation in accordance with Central Bank of Oman EDPBS 6/2016 and FATF Recommendation 12.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sijil – Omani Commercial Registry Portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) (online service via sijil.gov.om)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The commercial name must be written in Arabic script as the official record. A transliteration of the English trade name may be appended as a suffix. The name must be distinctive, not identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name, must not violate public order or morals, and must not contain a foreign word standing alone unless transliterated into Arabic.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank (without Central Bank of Oman license)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An applicant may submit one extension request for an additional 30 days before expiry. If the name is rejected, the applicant must file a written objection with the Commercial Registry Manager within 15 working days of the rejection notice, attaching the original reservation receipt and a copy of the rejection. The Manager refers the objection to the Registry Appeals Committee of MoCIIP, which must decide within 30 working days. If the appeal is denied, judicial review may be sought before the Administrative Court within 60 days from the notification of the denial.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for an immigration and visa consultancy business (ISIC 7810) because the sector requires a dedicated physical office for client file storage, regulatory inspection, and statutory physical presence under MoCIIP's licensing authority.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 65% – moderate-to-high risk; unannounced on-site inspections by MoCIIP Compliance Officers, the Ministry of Manpower, Royal Oman Police, and the Central Bank of Oman are common and can be made at any time without prior notice.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial name reservation and clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Ministerial Decision No. 188/2014 (Schedule of Commercial Registry Fees)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation AML/CFT due diligence and UBO piercing dossier (PEP/sanctions screening, source of funds verification, beneficial-ownership analysis)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Omani AML/CFT consultancy or external legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a medium-risk immigration consultancy required by CBO EDPBS 6/2016 and FATF Recommendation 10

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of UBO passport copies, proof of address, and Memorandum of Association preliminary draft
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Omani notary public / Real Estate Notarization Department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary fees under Ministerial Decision No. 32/2020 and certified translation expenses

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Consular legalization of foreign public documents required for UBO identification (passport, police clearance, bank reference, address proof)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Omani Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Consular Section) and the Omani Embassy in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular tariff per MoFA 'fees schedule' – approximately USD 60 per document with 5 documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Arabic translation of all UBO and corporate documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of OMR 15–20 per standard page; estimated 15 pages including apostille/legalization stamps

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the Single Person Company (SPC) Memorandum of Association and Pre-incorporation Regulatory Compliance Opinion
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External legal counsel admitted before the Omani courts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark based on legal retainers for pre-incorporation drafting; may be credited against final incorporation fees upon engagement

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (as amended), Single Person Company chapter (Articles 258–265); Foreign Investment Promotion Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2019; Commercial Activity Law, Royal Decree No. 100/2020; MoCIIP Ministerial Decision No. 209/2020 (corporate governance and registration procedures).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — Companies Registration Directorate / Commercial Registry, one-stop shop through InvestEasy portal (investeasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Incorporation Application (InvestEasy CR-1), Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association (MOA/AOA) in Arabic, and Certificate of Incorporation (Commercial Registration Extract).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on an Omani SPC; the sole shareholder fixes the capital in the MOA and must fully subscribe it (payment may be spread over not more than 10 years from incorporation). No escrow account is mandated by company law; however, client funds received for study-abroad and residence-visa facilitation must be segregated in a dedicated escrow/retainer account under ROP DGPR licensing conditions and CBO AML/CFT expectations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The sole shareholder approves the subscription of the entire issued share capital and adopts the Memorandum and Articles of Association filed with the Commercial Registry. (2) The registered office address stated in the Memorandum is adopted as the Company's statutory seat for all notices and service of process. (3) [Name of sole shareholder or appointee] is appointed as Manager with full authority to open bank and escrow accounts, execute client agreements, and sign regulatory filings. (4) The Manager is directed to obtain the study-abroad and residence-visa sectoral licences and to maintain the statutory records. (5) All prior and incidental acts are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Name Reservation Unit via InvestEasy (investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into InvestEasy using an Oman Digital ID or licensed agent credentials; run a name availability search with up to three English/Arabic trade names; select the legal form 'Single Person Company (SPC)' and the target activity class mapping ISIC 7810 (educational consulting, student placement and immigration/residence advisory); pay the name reservation fee electronically; download the trade-name reservation certificate, valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Valid passport copy of the non-resident sole shareholder
Notarized power of attorney appointing the resident formation agent
InvestEasy name reservation application form
Proposed Arabic/English trade names and logo concept
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is refused for similarity to an existing Commercial Registration or for public-order reasons, the applicant may immediately re-submit two or three alternative names within the same application reference; a formal appeal may be lodged with the MoCIIP Name Dispute Committee within 15 working days on grounds of trademark priority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Approval of SPC Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Corporate Registration Department — Approval Unit, with licensed notary public attestation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Arabic MOA/AOA in conformity with RD 18/2019, setting out the corporate name, registered office governorate, object clause limited to ISIC 7810 services, subscribed capital, and SPC governance provisions; the sole shareholder or attorney must sign before a public notary; upload the certified MOA/AOA and supporting deeds to InvestEasy for legal-form validation; pay the incorporation approval fee; obtain the official approval letter for registration.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (Arabic)
Trade-name reservation certificate
Notarized power of attorney of the sole shareholder
First board/sole-shareholder resolution appointing the Manager
Ejara (attested lease) for the proposed registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registration Examiner issues a query on the object clause, capital instalment schedule, or shareholding identity, the company may file an amended supplementary MOA/AOA and re-submit electronically within 7 days; correction of a notarial attestation is made by the same notary without a fresh set of statutory fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration and Entry into the Companies Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry (CR Section) via InvestEasy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the incorporation application by entering the approved trade name, registered office address, subscribed/paid-up capital figures, and the Manager's civil identity details; validate the notarized MOA/AOA against the registry records; pay the Commercial Registration issuance fee; upon approval, download the electronic Commercial Registration (CR) extract and Certificate of Incorporation, which confer legal personality and 100% foreign ownership.
required_dossiers: MoCIIP approval letter of the MOA/AOA
Attested Ejara (lease) for the registered office
Copy of the Manager's national ID or valid employment/residence permit
Sole shareholder declaration (no competing activity in Oman)
Accepted first board resolution on registered office and appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the CR is rejected for an activity-code mismatch, MoCIIP maps ISIC 7810 to the recognized Omani activity tariff (educational and career counselling services / visa facilitation); the applicant files a no-fee correction (Tadeel) substituting the exact activity description, preserving the original registry fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality Business Licensing Department (or the competent governorate municipality for offices outside Muscat)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the CR extract and attested Ejara through the municipal e-services platform; obtain the Civil Defense fit-out approval for the premises; a municipality inspector verifies floor area, signage, and conformity of the office use; upon passing inspection, pay the annual municipal fee and receive the Sijil, which authorizes physical operation of the consultancy office.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration (CR) extract
Attested lease contract and floor plan
Civil Defense and Ambulance Department no-objection certificate
Manager's passport copy and residence status
Landlord no-objection letter for external signage
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality imposes a different activity tariff, the license application is re-routed to the 'Offices of Private Education and Student Services' category upon submission of the corrected CR; an administrative appeal against the classification may be filed with the Municipality Licensing Appeals Committee within 10 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration, VAT Number and Chamber of Commerce Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) — Taxpayer Registration; Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) Membership Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the OTA online taxpayer registration using the CR number; obtain the Corporate Income Tax registration certificate (15% CIT) and the tax identification number; if taxable supplies are expected to exceed OMR 38,500 in the next 12 months, file the VAT registration request (standard rate 5%); concurrently submit the OCCI membership application and pay the annual chamber fee to obtain the chamber certificate required for apostille, attestation and trade operations.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration and Sijil
Passport copies of the sole shareholder and Manager
Board resolution designating the tax representative
Bank account confirmation or capital subscription statement
OCCI membership application form and fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA defers the TIN due to incomplete substance information, the company files a supplementary form (registered office, staffing, local bank account) within 15 days; late-registration exposure is minimized if the OTA application is evidenced by the portal acknowledgement. VAT threshold determinations may be administratively reviewed under the Oman VAT Law upon submission of projected service revenue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Sectoral Licensing and Escrow Banking — Study-Abroad Agency and Residence Visa Facilitation Permit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Royal Oman Police — Directorate General of Passports and Residence Affairs (DGPR); Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (MoHERI) — Private Academic Agencies Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the SPC CR, Sijil, the Manager's and consultants' police clearances, and academic-offer/affiliation evidence with DGPR for the foreigner-residence and visa-facilitation services license; simultaneously submit the study-abroad agency accreditation package to MoHERI, including foreign university authorization letters; upon approval, open a dedicated escrow/trust account at a licensed Omani bank for client visa retainer funds and deposit the subscribed SPC capital, confirming compliance with the license conditions.
required_dossiers: Commercial Registration and Sijil
Police clearance certificates (manager and client-facing staff)
Foreign university affiliation / authorization agreements
Professional liability or guarantee insurance certificate
AML/CFT compliance manual for the escrow-based service model
DGPR/MoHERI physical inspection clearance report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGPR requests evidence of operational track record, the applicant may cure by producing a bank reference from a licensed Omani bank and a written undertaking to release visa fees to suppliers only after visa-application submission; a MoHERI accreditation refusal may be appealed to the Higher Education Council within 20 working days after correcting the accreditation file.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Royal Oman Police — Directorate General of Passports and Residence Affairs (licensing of visa and residence facilitation services) and Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation (study-abroad agency accreditation); no manufacturing or industrial licensing board applies to ISIC 7810 service activities.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreigner Residence and Visa Facilitation Services License (ROP DGPR) and Private Study-Abroad Agency Accreditation Certificate (MoHERI), supplemented by the municipal commercial Sijil for the office premises.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority, Sultanate of Oman (formerly Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 — Service and Office-Based Activity: no full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) or Environmental Design Dossier is required; the SPC is subject to a simplified environmental self-registration and municipal waste-handling declaration only.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC point sources exist for this activity; sanitary wastewater must connect to the public Muscat sewerage network where available, or otherwise to an approved on-site septic system conforming to Omani Standards for domestic sewage; HVAC installations must use ozone-friendly refrigerants per Oman's Montreal Protocol implementation (Ministerial Decree 7/2014); general and electronic waste must be collected by licensed municipal/private waste operators with a retained disposal manifest; office noise must remain within the permissible workplace limits applicable to administrative premises.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and structural clearance from the Civil Defense and Ambulance Department (Royal Oman Police) covering extinguishers, emergency exits, alarms, signage, and fire-load inspection of the leased office; an occupancy/structural load certificate for the office unit issued by the Muscat Municipality Building Regulation Directorate; and an occupational health clearance from the Ministry of Labour confirming adequate floor area, ventilation, sanitary facilities, and first-aid provision for staff engaged in visa-processing and student-advisory work.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA), Sultanate of Oman, Ministry of Finance; official e-tax portal: taxoman.gov.om
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The foreign shareholder must first incorporate the Single Person Company (SPC) in the Commercial Register at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and obtain a Commercial Registration (CR) number. Using the CR certificate, constitutional documents, authorized signatory details, and a certified power of attorney, an online application is filed with the Oman Tax Authority e-tax portal to obtain the Tax Card / Tax Identification Number (TIN). The VAT registration is a separate online application to the OTA VAT system and is required only when taxable supplies equal or exceed the statutory threshold, or may be filed voluntarily when the voluntary threshold is met. Completion of procurement is conditional on valid commercial licensing, economic substance documentation, and local municipal registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman does not operate a U.S.-style 'check-the-box' election or a domestic hybrid-mismatch election. The SPC is taxed as a standalone resident juridical person under Royal Decree No. 28/2009 (Income Tax Law) on its worldwide taxable income, with foreign tax credit relief available under applicable tax treaties. Tax grouping may be elected by forming a resident corporate group under OTA conditions; an Advance Pricing Arrangement may be applied for cross-border transactions; treaty-reduced withholding rates may be accessed through a valid Oman tax residence certificate. No pass-through or LLC-style classification election is available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Oman VAT Law and its Executive Regulations, aligned with the GCC Unified VAT Agreement
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: OMR 500,000 in annual taxable supplies for mandatory registration; OMR 250,000 for voluntary registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman currently does not mandate a real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control digital stamping, or authority-validated e-invoicing platform for VAT. Taxpayers are obliged to file VAT returns electronically via the taxoman.gov.om portal and to maintain digital and machine-readable tax invoice records in Arabic and English. Commercial invoices and tax invoices must be retained for at least five years. The OTA may conduct automated risk-based audits and require API-based bulk data submission in the course of an audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under Oman VAT is available for goods exported outside the Sultanate where the supplier or authorized exporter proves that the goods physically left Oman within the prescribed period and that the supply is made to a person outside Oman. For cross-border services supplied by the SPC (e.g., study-abroad placement and golden visa consultancy), zero-rating is claimable if the recipient is a non-resident, the recipient belongs outside Oman, the services are not performed in whole or in part for exploitation in Oman, and the underlying documentation establishes the foreign destination and the economic benefit outside Oman. Ancillary services directly related to exported goods may also be zero-rated if supported by the export evidence. Documentation must be contemporaneous and kept for audit.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic Bayan export declaration accepted by Oman Customs)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency
Service Agreement and engagement letter for cross-border study-abroad or immigration consultancy
Evidence of non-resident status of the foreign recipient (e.g., overseas passport, foreign tax identification number, residence address)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Oman Tax Authority may reopen VAT returns within the statutory period and deny export zero-rating where the mandatory export evidence or foreign currency repatriation proof is incomplete, non-contemporaneous, or unreliable. Reassessment will claw back all input VAT credits previously claimed, require payment of the unrecovered 5% VAT, and impose late-payment charges calculated on each unpaid month, in addition to administrative fines per invoice. Fraudulent or repeated misuse of export zero-rating is subject to enhanced financial penalties, interest, criminal prosecution and possible imprisonment for responsible directors or managers. The OTA may also apply retrospective clawback extending across multiple tax periods where a scheme or arrangement demonstrates intent to defraud the VAT system.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO; البنك المركزي العماني) acting under the Law of Banking Business (Royal Decree 114/2000, as amended), the Central Bank of Oman Law, and the Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Law (Royal Decree 30/2016, as amended); AML/CFT supervision is coordinated with the National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (NCFC) and the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) domiciled at the CBO.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible on both the current and capital accounts; a no-exchange-control policy is applied and non-resident 100% ownership is permitted under the Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree 50/2019, amended by Royal Decree 74/2022). The Rial operates a fixed peg to the USD (USD 1 = OMR 0.3845; OMR 1 = USD 2.6008) maintained by the CBO, so repatriation of dividends, profit remittances, repayment of shareholder loans, and capital repatriation are cleared freely through authorized banks subject only to AML/CFT documentary due diligence and CRS/FATCA reporting. For the ISIC 7810 study-abroad and immigration-advisory SPC, education-consultancy and visa-service fees may be received in OMR, USD, EUR, or GBP and converted without prior central-bank approval, provided the underlying invoices and client mandates are retained.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable: Oman imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no deferred-receipt timeline for service or consulting receipts. The SPC may retain its cross-border education-placement and immigration-consultancy earnings in the original currency or convert them freely on the CBO pegged parity; the only statutory duties are the general obligation to maintain auditable source-of-funds evidence, to report suspicious transactions to the CBO FIU under Royal Decree 30/2016, and to submit balance-of-payments statistical declarations where requested by the CBO.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW. Offshore digital EMIs (UK/EEA/MENA e-money institutions) are not regulated by the CBO and cannot act as the primary treasury or escrow clearing rail for the Omani SPC; holding client deposits outside the CBO-licensed banking system breaches the Banking Law payment-settlement framework and creates material CRS/FATCA misclassification risk. An EEA- or FCA-licensed EMI may be used only as an ancillary online student-deposit collection node if it sweeps funds automatically on a daily basis into the CBO-licensed country account and the SPC never maintains overnight substitutive balances outside Oman.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for the first corporate-account opening: Omani banks require at least one resident signatory (the Omani-resident General Manager or authorized person) and the non-resident UBO to appear in person for biometric capture and a face-to-face CDD interview under CBO AML/CFT Circulars. Fully remote opening is not available for a 100% foreign-owned SPC in the immigration-consulting sector; when hybrid video-KYC is permitted, the bank still requires a notarized and apostilled power of attorney, MoCIIP-attested Commercial Registration and Memorandum of Association, non-resident UBO passport and tax ID, and in-person signature-card activation within 30 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border funds opacity: incoming UBO remittances and onward payments to overseas universities and visa authorities with inconsistent SWIFT purpose codes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle comprising (i) apostilled/notarized Commercial Registration and Memorandum of Association plus UBO passport and tax-ID/TIN; (ii) 6-12 months of clean home-country bank statements for the UBO and parent entity; (iii) executed escrow or collection mandates and student-service agreements detailing fee milestones; (iv) admission letters and university proforma invoices matching outbound MT103 references; (v) CRS/FATCA self-certification form; and (vi) a 12-month projected cash-flow statement signed by the bank-appointed relationship officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Medium-Risk Enhanced classification: immigration/visa advisory is treated as a DNFBP-adjacent activity exposed to third-party remittances and citizenship-type client flows.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle comprising (i) statutory operating license evidence under Foreign Capital Investment Law RD 50/2019 plus any sectoral education-placement bureau approval; (ii) written client source-of-wealth and source-of-funds questionnaire procedure; (iii) completed OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening results with all hits resolved; (iv) NCFC STR escalation protocol certified by the compliance officer; (v) third-party agreements with universities and immigration lawyers evidencing commercial rationale; and (vi) opening audited balance sheet proving collected fees are service consideration and not custodial client money mislabeled.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity and nominee-shareholder risk: the SPC has a single non-resident shareholder and local bank records may not identify the ultimate controller.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle comprising (i) completed CBO Beneficial Owner Declaration filed in the Oman Commercial Registry; (ii) full ownership-chain diagram ending at a named natural person, with passport and Omani or GCC residence proof; (iii) sworn affidavit confirming no local nominee holds shares; (iv) ABA-format bank reference letter from the UBO home bank covering 12 months; and (v) board resolution appointing the resident authorized signatory and assigning UBO attestation rights.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for equity injection: UBO or foreign parent initiates SWIFT MT103 from its own bank account to the SPC's CBO-licensed beneficiary account, using IMF BPM6 category 521 (Direct Investment Equity Capital) in the purpose/beneficiary information field together with the Omani Commercial Registration number and CIF number in field 72. There is no minimum paid-in capital, but the credit must be supported on arrival by a board resolution recording the subscription and a letter from the applicant's home bank confirming the remitter's identity; the USD-to-OMR conversion, when executed at the CBO peg, must be evidenced by the FX confirmation ticket. If the injection is structured as a shareholder loan instead of equity, the SPC must file the executed loan agreement with the corporate signatory to prevent the bank from reclassifying the receipt as taxable revenue; statistical reporting of the inward FDI receipt to the CBO is completed by the receiving bank within 30 days.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail is SWIFT MT103 for service-based outflows: tuition deposits and admission fees to overseas universities, visa-package remittances to embassies or immigration counsel, and agent-commission payments to foreign education partners, each carrying a BPM6 service purpose code (Education Services, Business Consultancy, or Legal Services) and a narrative citing the underlying contract number and student file or visa reference. The SPC must maintain a segregated client-money escrow ledger so collected student deposits are never co-mingled with operational fee income, and all outbound wires to higher-risk recipient corridors (Pakistan, Egypt, Iraq, Yemen and Iran-adjacent banks) must include sanctions-screening certificates and, where routed via Islamic windows, a Shari'ah compliance declaration. Same-day settlement is cleared through the CBO-operated eMIRAB real-time gross settlement system or via Omani bank correspondent accounts; Commercial Letters of Credit (MT700) are considered irrelevant to a services-only study-abroad SPC and are not recommended.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable outright FX forward (USD/OMR) executed with a CBO-licensed commercial bank at the pegged parity for treasury certainty
Foreign-exchange swap or rollover (USD/OMR) for staggered student-tuition funding buckets
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) on non-pegged corridor currencies such as EUR, GBP, INR, PKR, EGP, TRY and MAD for tuition and overseas agent-commission payables
Vanilla European FX option (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/AED) for committed study-abroad pipeline hedging above three-month money market thresholds
Cross-currency swap (CCS) for multi-year flows above USD 5 million between the Omani SPC and its foreign parent or university counterparties
Shari'ah-compliant FX hedging structures (Tahawwut, wakala-murabaha) available through Alizz Islamic Bank and Bank Nizwa for Islamic-window-compliant treasury accounts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) via the Invest Easy electronic portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the registration anniversary date recorded on the commercial register; renewal application opens on the first day of the anniversary month
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal accrues escalating administrative fines per month of delay; a CR lapsed for more than 90 days may trigger deregistration, and lapse beyond one year leads to administrative strike-off of the SPC and compulsory liquidation under the Omani Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Return and Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six (6) months after the close of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, filing and payment are due by 30 June of the following calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-filing penalty of 1% of the tax due per month is imposed, subject to a maximum cap of 50% of the tax due; unpaid tax accrues monthly interest; persistent non-filing triggers a tax assessment, additional evasion penalties, and refusal of the annual CR renewal by the MoCIIP.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Prepared by an Omani-licensed auditor registered with the Oman Association of Accountants and Auditors; filed to the OTA with the CIT return and available to the MoCIIP for CR renewal verification
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four (4) months after the fiscal year-end for audit completion and approval by the sole shareholder; audited accounts must accompany the CIT filing only when required by the OTA
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to appoint an auditor or to complete the statutory audit results in administrative fines under the Commercial Companies Law; missing audited accounts may invalidate the CR renewal and enable a discretionary tax assessment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) Confirmation and Shareholding Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Register through the Invest Easy portal; UBO register and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) files retained at the registered office for inspection by the Oman Tax Authority and sectoral AML supervisors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation is embedded in the CR renewal application; any share transfer, change of beneficial ownership, or change of director must be reported to the commercial register within 30 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of OMR 100–500 apply for late UBO notification, inaccurate registers, or failure to maintain the UBO record; non-disclosure may trigger AML/CFT enforcement action and suspension of share transfer rights.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Sole Shareholder Annual Written Resolution (Approval of Audited Accounts and Discharge of Management)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: No external filing; resolution recorded in the statutory minute book maintained at the registered office and required for the validity of the annual accounts
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four (4) months after the fiscal year-end, concurrent with the audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-issuance leaves the annual accounts unapproved, prevents lawful CR renewal, and constitutes a breach of the Commercial Companies Law subject to personal liability of the manager.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No turnover or capital exemption: every Omani Single Person Company, regardless of size, revenue, or headcount, must appoint an independent auditor licensed and registered in the Sultanate of Oman from the first fiscal year of incorporation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Oman; IFRS for SMEs is acceptable for a non-publicly accountable SPC, provided the OTA and MoCIIP accept simplified presentation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019) and the Omani AML/CFT framework, the SPC must identify, verify, and record all ultimate beneficial owners holding 25% or more of ownership, voting rights, or effective control. The UBO register and CDD files must be current at the registered office at all times. The annual CR renewal submitted through the Invest Easy portal constitutes the mandatory annual UBO confirmation; any share transfer or change in shareholding requires updating the UBO register and filing a commercial-register notification within 30 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 – 3,000 per annum for registered office address, PO Box, and local corporate agent services in Muscat
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,800 – 6,500 per annum for a medium-risk advisory SPC requiring an Omani-licensed auditor and IFRS-based reporting

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 3% preferential rate applies to taxable income not exceeding OMR 30,000 for qualifying small taxpayers; no automatic tax holiday for a mainland consulting SPC; free-zone and Special Economic Zone exemptions (e.g., Duqm, Sohar, Salalah) are not available to an Oman-mainland visa advisory SPC; Oman applies OECD Pillar Two-aligned rules, including a 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax for MNE groups meeting the EUR 750 million consolidated revenue threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CIT-1 (Corporate Income Tax Return) filed electronically through the Oman Tax Authority (OTA) e-Filing Portal (taxoman.gov.om), with Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form TP-1 attached as a schedule.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four months after the close of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year SPC, on or before 30 April of the following year. A branch or permanent establishment (PE) of a non-resident company files on the same schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: tax card number, Commercial Registration number, legal form (Single Person Company), fiscal period start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the PE registration certificate number issued to the non-resident company and attach the OTA registration reference; use the PE's separate tax account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue: study-abroad placement commissions, immigration and golden-visa advisory retainers, university application processing fees, success fees and administrative charges received through escrow accounts and wire transfers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Oman-source revenue attributable to the PE; offshore fees incurred without any Omani PE activity must be separately disclosed and supported by contemporaneous documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions: staff salaries, office rent, marketing and compliance costs, professional indemnity insurance, AML/KYC customer due diligence costs, bank and escrow charges, and licence amortisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only direct expenses economically connected to Oman-source income are deductible; head-office overhead allocations to the PE are limited to the OECD arm's length allocable amount with no profit loading on cost-agent functions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjusted taxable income before current-year loss relief and carried-forward losses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must compute profit applying the separate-entity principle; a nil return is unacceptable without documented inactivity and a board resolution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year unabsorbed tax losses carried forward, limited to a maximum of five consecutive years under Oman's Income Tax Law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign head-office losses cannot be surrendered to the Omani PE; treaty non-discrimination provisions do not authorise cross-border loss pooling.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits: Oman withholding tax credits, foreign tax credit claims and any advance tax payments applicable to the assessment period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Oman WHT suffered on passive income is a final credit; foreign tax credit is capped at the Omani effective tax rate and must be supported by a Tax Residency Certificate and tax assessment statements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction declaration: controlled dealings with the foreign parent, sub-agents, overseas universities and immigration partners, including aggregate value, category and transfer pricing method applied.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all material cross-border controlled transactions; attach the Local File when aggregate Oman controlled transactions exceed OMR 2 million in the fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: taxable income at 15% headline rate (or 3% for qualifying small taxpayers), total tax payable, and net balance due after credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE is taxed at the standard 15% rate; the small-taxpayer 3% tier is unavailable to a non-resident branch without independent legal personality in Oman.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature: manager or sole shareholder sign-off, date, and acknowledgement of statutory truthfulness obligations.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be countersigned by the Oman-licensed auditor; audited annual financial statements must be uploaded with the return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: civil penalty of OMR 500 to OMR 2,000 plus monthly interest of 2% on the unpaid tax; underpayment penalty of up to 25% of the under-assessed tax; non-filing after repeated OTA notices triggers official estimated assessment plus up to 100% penalty on the evaded tax; directors and the sole shareholder are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid assessment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form (TP-1), filed as a mandatory schedule to Form CIT-1 through the OTA e-Filing Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Simultaneously with the corporate income tax return, i.e., no later than four months after fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identity, immediate parent, ultimate beneficial owner and country of tax residence of each related party.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent must be identified by full legal name, foreign registration number and tax residence country; a copy of the parent's TRC is expected on audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate value of controlled transactions by category: commission fees, success fees, intercompany service charges, royalties, reimbursed marketing costs, guarantee fees and loan interest.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report aggregate OMR value of dealings between the Omani entity and the foreign head office, sub-agents and university referral partners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Transfer pricing methodology applied (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM or Profit Split), the tested party, and the arm's length benchmark range.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The PE must demonstrate the Oman SPC earns at least a routine arm's length return for its functions, assets and risks; loss-making controlled services will be challenged.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of contemporaneous Local File, Master File and Country-by-Country Report availability for OTA audit request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Master File and CbC Report remain with the foreign parent; the Oman entity must be able to obtain and translate them within 30 days of an OTA notice.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or material mis-declaration of TP-1: fixed penalty of up to OMR 5,000, disallowance of the related deduction, upward profit adjustment to the arm's length margin, and monthly interest on the resulting additional tax; repeat violations may trigger a full TP audit of all intercompany flows.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends paid by the Omani SPC to a non-resident shareholder; no Omani WHT applies to dividends distributed to Oman-resident shareholders.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke DTA relief: (1) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the shareholder's tax residence authority covering the distribution year; (2) submit the OTA withholding tax relief application together with the board resolution, dividend declaration, TRC and detailed WHT computation before the dividend payment date; (3) apply the reduced DTA rate (typically 0%–10% depending on the treaty) at source only after OTA acknowledgement; (4) attach a dividend schedule and WHT summary to the annual CIT return; retain TRC and bank transfer evidence for at least five years. Any mailbox holding company lacking beneficial ownership will be denied treaty relief and recharacterised under general anti-abuse rules.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate: 10% gross withholding on IP royalties and 10% on debt interest paid to non-residents; treaty rates typically range from 0% to 10%; interest on approved bank financing or government-backed loans may be exempt under domestic law, and several Omani DTAs provide reduced or nil rates for portfolio interest and royalty income.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required when annual Oman controlled transactions exceed OMR 2,000,000; Master File required when consolidated group revenue exceeds OMR 30,000,000; Country-by-Country Report required when group revenue exceeds OMR 375,000,000; all taxpayers with any related-party transactions must file TP-1 with the annual CIT return.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has not enacted standalone UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; however, the Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 55/2023) codifies substance-over-form GAAR, controlled foreign company rules, and OECD Inclusive Framework implementation (Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax, Income Inclusion Rule and Undertaxed Profits Rule at 15% for MNE groups above the EUR 750 million threshold). The SPC must show real management in Oman, an operating office, resident placement and visa advisory staff, independent decision-making, and full income-recording substance; a passive letterbox vehicle will be disregarded, profits reattributed to Oman, and treaty or small-taxpayer benefits revoked.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting escrow-held study-abroad placement fees, wire-transfer commissions and success fees from gross revenue; inflating fictitious marketing and consultancy expenses; maintaining dual accounting records for the Omani SPC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Civil penalty of up to 100% of the under-assessed tax, compulsory recovery with monthly interest (2%), cancellation of loss-carryforward benefits, suspension of the SPC's tax clearance certificate, and criminal prosecution for tax fraud with fines up to OMR 20,000 and imprisonment of up to three years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Statutory veil-piercing: the sole shareholder, manager and any signatory director are jointly and severally liable for the unpaid corporate tax, penalties and interest; travel bans, asset freezes, disqualification from managing Omani companies and personal bankruptcy proceedings are triggered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company Disguise and Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SPC without an office or resident placement counsellors; booking all margins to a zero-tax or uncooperative offshore parent; maintaining only nominal university 'agency' contracts without active invoicing, staff or board decision-making in Oman.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: GAAR disallowance of intercompany payments, income recharacterisation, full 15% attribution of profit to the Omani PE or deemed resident entity, denial of treaty benefits, application of the 15% Qualified Domestic Minimum Top-Up Tax for MNE-parented groups, and strike-off or licence revocation under the Commercial Companies Law and the sectoral licensing regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the sole shareholder may be assessed personally where transferred assets or shell distributions render the SPC unable to pay tax; penalties of 50%–100% of recharacterised profit are imposed; immigration enforcement includes travel bans and debarment of the director's Oman residence card.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violations in Escrow and Wire Payment Handling
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving large inbound escrow payments and executing outward wires for golden-visa and study-abroad clients without customer due diligence, beneficial-ownership identification or source-of-funds verification; channelling visa-investment deposits through unlicensed structures; structuring wire or cash transfers to evade reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Omani Anti-Money Laundering Law (RD 30/2016 and 2020 amendments): administrative fines of OMR 10,000–50,000 per breach, revocation of the SPC's commercial registration and immigration-services licence, and criminal money-laundering prosecution with imprisonment of up to 15 years and fines up to OMR 250,000; confiscation of the escrow balance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers and the ultimate beneficial owner face personal criminal liability where tainted funds were known or should have been known; personal bank accounts are attached, international alerts trigger travel bans and asset freezes, and extradition becomes possible under bilateral mutual legal assistance instruments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Immigration and Visa Placement Practice
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting the ISIC 7810 study-abroad placement and golden-visa residence advisory business without the required sectoral licence (Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation authorisation, labour recruitment licensing where applicable, and approved investment-residence scheme appointment); charging non-refundable 'visa guarantee' success fees or promising guaranteed admission and residency outcomes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Cease-and-desist order from the competent licensing authority; administrative fine up to OMR 10,000 for unlicensed practice; voidance of client service contracts; restitution of all escrow-held fees; criminal sanctions under the Commercial Fraud and Consumer Protection Law with imprisonment of up to two years in serious cases.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The sole shareholder-director is personally liable to refund misappropriated escrow funds where the escrow account was used as a proprietary account, lifting the corporate veil; the director's Oman residence status is revoked, and the person is placed on the Royal Oman Police travel-lock list during investigation and prosecution.
